primary_inputs: Table I of the accepted author manuscript, Fig. 1 controller and circuit, Fig. 2 for the capacitor-retaining phasor approximation

assumptions.balanced_test: Grid magnitude is stepped from 1 to 0.5 pu and restored, with zero grid phase jump. Initialize each model at its own pre-fault steady state with P=0.8 pu.
assumptions.actuator: Ideal averaged converter voltage with the labelled 10 kHz sampler. Nominal reconstruction holds each sequence voltage command in the physical stationary frame for one sample; alternative cases test the choice of hold frame and one extra sample of latency.
assumptions.voltage_headroom: A separate sensitivity limits the bridge voltage to Vdc/sqrt(3) using the 700 V laboratory supply of reference [10] and the circular linear-modulation limit. This is a derived average-voltage sensitivity with the same current PI state update.
assumptions.pi_units: Electrical normalized time uses omega_b*Ki as the amplitude-normalized per-second integral rates. Also test the alternative where the printed integrator gains are applied directly in seconds. Table I does not identify DSP coefficients.
assumptions.antiwindup: Reset the voltage-PI integral state and omit its output when the computed reference would exceed the current limit. Test retaining the stored state with its output gated as a distinct interpretation. Use the circular projection exactly, with no additional hysteresis. Propagate the currents and capacitor voltage continuously through events.
assumptions.frequency_cross_terms: Physical plant equations use grid-synchronous dq; diagram feedforward uses the stated nominal grid angular frequency. Conversions to the controller frame use the integrated droop angle.
assumptions.power_lpf: Use the unfiltered capacitor-terminal P in the main reconstruction, as drawn in Fig. 1. The 50 Hz sensitivity comes from the cited laboratory setup in reference [10] and is not a confirmed filter setting for the letter.
